transcribe.durationMs: positive integer no greater than provider maximum

align.durationMs: positive integer within advertised known-text window
align.knownText: nonblank supplied text within core/provider UTF-8 and model-token budgets
align.language: optional language; defaults to en for alignment

status.knownTextAlignment: optional closed support/limits record; omitted legacy means unsupported

transcribe.segments: ordered segment array with optional word timestamps

align.segments: supplied text caption segments derived from actual aligned words
align.alignment: closed speech-alignment-v1 record with forced quality and actual producer/model identity
